title: UAAP: UST boys near Final 4 after sweeping UE

blocks.text: University of Santo Tomas extended its perfect run to eight matches after repulsing defending champion University of the East, 25-22, 25-20, 30-28, in the UAAP Season 89 boys' volleyball tournament on Tuesday at the Paco Arena.
